name: learn·wuwu 英语学习站
desc: 我做的英语学习站：分阶段学单词、音标、课程与影视跟读，AI 陪你逐句练。单词卡配间隔复习，影视短片按 CEFR 分级挑，还能在 3D 地球上「环游世界说英语」。
desc_en: An English learning site I built: learn words, phonetics, courses and shadowing with film clips in stages, with AI helping you practise sentence by sentence. Word cards come with spaced repetition, video clips are picked by CEFR level, and you can even "travel the world speaking English" on a 3D globe.
summary: 分阶段学单词、音标、课程与影视跟读，AI 陪你逐句练。已经上线，点开就能用。
summary_en: Learn words, phonetics, courses and shadowing with film clips in stages, with AI helping you practise sentence by sentence. It's live — open it and start.

name: AI 知识库
desc: 用 Claude Code 加 Obsidian 搭的一套自用知识库：资料丢进去，AI 按我写的 SOP 通读、写摘要、交叉引用，还会定期体检 —— 查互相矛盾的结论、没人链接的孤立条目、该补的缺口。
desc_en: A knowledge base for my own use, built with Claude Code plus Obsidian: I drop material in, and AI reads it all the way through following an SOP I wrote, writes summaries, adds cross-references, and gives the whole thing a regular checkup — looking for conclusions that contradict each other, orphaned entries nobody links to, and gaps that need filling.
summary: 资料丢进去，AI 按我写的 SOP 通读、写摘要、交叉引用，还会定期体检 —— 查互相矛盾的结论、没人链接的孤立条目、该补的缺口。
summary_en: I drop material in, and AI reads it all the way through following an SOP I wrote, writes summaries, adds cross-references, and gives the whole thing a regular checkup — looking for conclusions that contradict each other, orphaned entries nobody links to, and gaps that need filling.
